 stamp book is ready at last!

"The prizes you can trade for on this page
 are wonderful, so look forward to them.
id./gamecmn.pack|script_message.bxon|600c:

 working hard to prepare it.

 the Royal Medal Academy.

"From now on, bring small medals here
 and I'll stamp your book for each one.

"You'll get splendid prizes by your
 stamp count, so do collect small medals!
id./gamecmn.pack|script_message.bxon|68d4:
"I'm sorry, but this branch can only
 stamp up to page 1.
id./gamecmn.pack|script_message.bxon|69b8:

 Medal at the Royal Medal Academy,
 our headquarters.
